title: The Spare Parts That Looked Like Waste
title_ja: 無駄に見えた予備部品
fact_notes: OECDの供給網の強靱性・貿易の利点とリスク管理の両立を参照。メーカーと事例は架空。
英文・全文対訳・設問・解説は独自制作。

sentences.en: A company producing medical equipment once considered itself exceptionally efficient because almost no unused materials remained in its warehouse.
sentences.ja: ある医療機器メーカーは、倉庫に使われない材料がほとんど残らないため、自社を非常に効率的だと考えていました。

sentences.en: Managers ordered components shortly before they were needed, thereby reducing storage expenses and releasing money for other investments.
sentences.ja: 管理者は必要になる少し前に部品を注文し、保管費を減らして他の投資に資金を回していました。

sentences.en: A single supplier offered reliable deliveries at attractive prices, and quarterly reports celebrated the resulting improvement in financial performance.
sentences.ja: 一社の供給業者が魅力的な価格で安定した納品を行い、四半期報告書は財務実績の改善を称賛していました。

sentences.en: However, a sudden interruption at a major transport hub prevented the supplier from sending essential parts for several weeks.
sentences.ja: しかし主要な輸送拠点で突然中断が起こり、その業者は数週間にわたり必要な部品を送れなくなりました。

sentences.en: The manufacturer discovered that equipment waiting for one inexpensive component could not be completed, despite the availability of everything else.
sentences.ja: メーカーは他のものがすべてそろっていても、一つの安価な部品を待つ機器は完成できないと知りました。

sentences.en: An arrangement that looked ideal during ordinary conditions had quietly removed alternatives that might have mattered during an emergency.
sentences.ja: 通常時には理想的に見えた仕組みが、緊急時に重要だったかもしれない代替策をひそかに取り除いていたのです。

sentences.en: The difficulty illustrates a distinction between efficiency and resilience that is easily hidden by a single financial measurement.
sentences.ja: この困難は、一つの財務指標では隠れやすい効率性と回復力の違いを示しています。

sentences.en: Efficiency concerns how effectively resources produce an intended result under particular conditions, whereas resilience concerns how a system responds when those conditions change.
sentences.ja: 効率性は特定の条件で資源が意図した結果をどれほど効果的に生むかに関わり、回復力は条件が変わったときの対応に関わります。

sentences.en: These qualities need not be enemies, but maximizing narrowly defined savings may reduce the capacity to absorb unexpected interruptions.
sentences.ja: 二つの性質は敵対する必要はありませんが、狭く定義された節約を最大化すると予期しない中断に耐える力が減るかもしれません。

sentences.en: For example, storing additional components appears costly until a delayed shipment makes the reserve necessary for continued production.
sentences.ja: 例えば部品の追加在庫は、貨物遅延で生産を続けるために必要になるまでは高価に見えます。

sentences.en: A second supplier may also seem unnecessary if the first has rarely failed, even though changing suppliers during a crisis could take months.
sentences.ja: 最初の業者に問題がほとんどなければ二社目も不要に見えますが、危機時の業者変更には数か月かかるかもしれません。

sentences.en: The important question is therefore which costs appear in ordinary accounts and which potential losses remain outside the calculation.
sentences.ja: したがって重要なのは、通常の会計に現れる費用と計算の外に残る潜在的損失が何かという問いです。

sentences.en: Some observers respond to supply chain risks by arguing that every country should manufacture all essential goods within its own territory.
sentences.ja: 供給網の危険に対し、各国が必要不可欠な商品をすべて自国で製造すべきだと主張する人々もいます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, complete self-sufficiency would not automatically remove natural disasters, equipment failures, or shortages of specialized knowledge.
sentences.ja: それでも完全な自給は自然災害、設備故障、専門知識の不足を自動的に取り除くものではありません。

sentences.en: The OECD discusses resilience as a matter of coordinated risk management that preserves the benefits of international economic connections.
sentences.ja: OECDは国際経済のつながりの利点を保つ、協調的なリスク管理の問題として回復力を論じています。

sentences.en: Several sources of supply can offer flexibility, yet diversification is meaningful only when alternatives do not share exactly the same vulnerability.
sentences.ja: 複数の供給源は柔軟性を与えますが、代替先が全く同じ弱点を共有しない場合にのみ多様化は意味を持ちます。

sentences.en: Two firms located in different countries, for instance, might still depend on one processing plant or the same congested port.
sentences.ja: 例えば別の国にある二社でも、一つの加工工場や同じ混雑した港に頼っている場合があります。

sentences.en: A list of suppliers is therefore less informative than a map of the actual dependencies connecting their operations.
sentences.ja: したがって供給業者の一覧は、業務をつなぐ実際の依存関係を示す地図ほど情報量がありません。

sentences.en: The company's directors begin tracing the origin and transport routes of the components whose absence would stop production entirely.
sentences.ja: その会社の経営陣は、欠けると生産が完全に止まる部品の生産元と輸送経路を追跡し始めます。

sentences.en: They distinguish parts that are easy to replace from those requiring specialized production processes, strict specifications, or lengthy approval.
sentences.ja: 容易に交換できる部品と、専門的な製造工程、厳密な規格、長い承認期間を要する部品を区別します。

sentences.en: Instead of demanding equal stocks of every item, they calculate where a modest reserve would provide the greatest protection.
sentences.ja: すべての品目に同じ在庫量を求めるのではなく、少量の予備在庫が最大の保護を与える場所を計算します。

sentences.en: They also test whether a backup supplier could satisfy technical requirements before any disruption makes such a test urgent.
sentences.ja: 混乱が検証を緊急にする前に、予備業者が技術的要件を満たせるかも試します。

sentences.en: These preparations cost money now, but their value cannot be judged solely by the number of parts sitting unused on a shelf.
sentences.ja: こうした準備は今お金がかかりますが、その価値は棚に未使用で置かれる部品数だけで評価できません。

sentences.en: Their purpose is to preserve options, not to promise that a complex system can ever become completely immune to failure.
sentences.ja: 目的は選択肢を残すことであり、複雑な仕組みが故障と無縁になると約束することではありません。

sentences.en: A further problem is that a disruption produces consequences for people whose interests do not appear in the manufacturer's financial statements.
sentences.ja: さらに、中断はメーカーの財務諸表に利益が表れない人々にも影響を及ぼします。

sentences.en: Executives may measure lost revenue, while employees worry about uncertain working hours and hospitals face delays in receiving necessary devices.
sentences.ja: 経営者は売上の損失を測り、従業員は不確かな勤務時間を心配し、病院は必要機器の受領遅延に直面するかもしれません。

sentences.en: If an emergency plan considers only the firm's immediate costs, it may neglect harms that customers and workers regard as more serious.
sentences.ja: 緊急時計画が企業の目先の費用だけを考えるなら、顧客や労働者がより深刻とみなす害を軽視するかもしれません。

sentences.en: The directors therefore consult affected groups about which products should receive priority when not every order can be completed.
sentences.ja: そこで経営陣はすべての注文を完成できない場合にどの製品を優先すべきか、影響を受ける集団に相談します。

sentences.en: Transparent communication does not remove shortages, but it allows people to adjust plans instead of discovering unexpected delays too late.
sentences.ja: 透明な情報伝達は不足をなくしませんが、予想外の遅延を手遅れになって知るのではなく、計画を調整できるようにします。

sentences.en: Resilience, viewed this way, includes relationships and trust as well as inventory, contracts, and transport networks.
sentences.ja: この視点からみると回復力には、在庫、契約、輸送網だけでなく人間関係や信頼も含まれます。

sentences.en: After reviewing the interruption, the manufacturer continues seeking efficiency but adopts a broader definition of successful performance.
sentences.ja: 中断を振り返った後、メーカーは効率性を追求し続けながら、成功した実績をより広く定義するようになります。

sentences.en: It now asks how quickly essential production could resume after the loss of a supplier, rather than assuming ordinary deliveries will continue.
sentences.ja: 通常の納品が続くと決めつけるのではなく、供給業者を失った後に必要な生産をどれほど早く再開できるかを問います。

sentences.en: It also examines whether different supply routes are genuinely independent and which groups would bear the heaviest consequences of another failure.
sentences.ja: 異なる供給経路が本当に独立しているか、次の故障でどの集団が最も重い影響を負うかも調べます。

sentences.en: As a result, additional inventory no longer appears merely as wasted space but as one possible investment in the capacity to adapt.
sentences.ja: その結果、追加在庫は単なる無駄な空間ではなく、適応する力への一つの投資に見えるようになります。

sentences.en: The company accepts that no strategy can eliminate uncertainty, so plans must be reviewed when new information challenges earlier assumptions.
sentences.ja: どんな戦略も不確実性を取り除けないため、新しい情報が以前の前提を疑わせたら計画を見直すべきだと受け入れます。

sentences.en: A system can be genuinely efficient only if the evaluation considers both the benefits achieved today and the vulnerability that tomorrow may expose.
sentences.ja: 今日得られる利益と明日明らかになる弱点の両方を評価する場合にのみ、仕組みは本当の意味で効率的と言えるでしょう。

questions.prompt: What disrupts the manufacturer's normal business?
options: An increase in the number of warehouses.
A sudden change in product color.
An interruption at a transport hub.
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落の「しかし主要な輸送拠点で突然中断が起こり、その業者は数週間にわたり必要な部品を送れなくなりました。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: How is resilience different from efficiency?
options: It is identical to producing cheaply.
It means no company can ever fail.
It concerns responding when conditions change.
It means using the least money at every moment.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落の「効率性は特定の条件で資源が意図した結果をどれほど効果的に生むかに関わり、回復力は条件が変わったときの対応に関わります。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: Why can additional components in storage be useful?
options: They guarantee larger sales in every month.
They allow production to continue when deliveries are delayed.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落の「例えば部品の追加在庫は、貨物遅延で生産を続けるために必要になるまでは高価に見えます。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: Why might national self-sufficiency be insufficient?
options: It cannot remove every type of failure or knowledge shortage.
It requires all countries to have identical resources.
It means the end of every business.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落の「それでも完全な自給は自然災害、設備故障、専門知識の不足を自動的に取り除くものではありません。」が根拠です。

options: When all firms depend on one processing plant.
When every route uses the same port.
When sources do not share critical vulnerabilities.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落の「複数の供給源は柔軟性を与えますが、代替先が全く同じ弱点を共有しない場合にのみ多様化は意味を持ちます。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: What do the directors calculate about reserves?
options: Which parts are the most colorful.
Where a modest reserve would offer the greatest protection.
How to store equal amounts of all components.
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落の「すべての品目に同じ在庫量を求めるのではなく、少量の予備在庫が最大の保護を与える場所を計算します。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: Why test a backup supplier before a crisis?
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落の「混乱が検証を緊急にする前に、予備業者が技術的要件を満たせるかも試します。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: What can a plan based only on immediate firm costs overlook?
options: Serious consequences for workers and customers.
The price of components in the accounts.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落の「緊急時計画が企業の目先の費用だけを考えるなら、顧客や労働者がより深刻とみなす害を軽視するかもしれません。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: How does the company reinterpret spare inventory?
options: As proof that every employee is inefficient.
As evidence that all trade is harmful.
As a guarantee of perfect safety.
As a possible investment in adaptability.
questions.explanation_ja: 第6段落の「その結果、追加在庫は単なる無駄な空間ではなく、適応する力への一つの投資に見えるようになります。」が根拠です。

questions.prompt: What is the writer's main conclusion?
options: Buying from a single supplier always creates perfect safety.
Real efficiency must consider potential future weaknesses as well as present benefits.
A firm can succeed only by storing everything.
questions.explanation_ja: 第6段落の「今日得られる利益と明日明らかになる弱点の両方を評価する場合にのみ、仕組みは本当の意味で効率的と言えるでしょう。」が根拠です。
